title: What's new at Bitly? – Bitly Support
markdown:
### Articles in this section

- [What's new at Bitly?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly)

# September 2026

## AI traffic for individual links

See which of your links AI assistants like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity are visiting. Each link's details page now has an AI traffic card that shows estimated AI visits for your selected date range, how that compares to the previous period, and which assistants visit most. You can download the data as a CSV with a breakdown by assistant.

AI visits are reported separately, so your engagement totals still reflect visits from people only.

No AI traffic on a link yet? Tell us your goal for that link right from the card. Your answer helps us decide which AI traffic tools to build next.

AI traffic is available on all paid Bitly plans.

**Learn more**:

[What is agentic traffic, and how do I see it on my Bitly links?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/47718961753613)

## Build Bitly Pages with the API and MCP

You can now create and manage Bitly Pages programmatically. Build a Page at a short URL you choose, fill it with content, style it, and publish it, all without opening the Bitly app.

What you can do:

- Create a Bitly Page at a short URL you choose, with a title and description.
- Add content to a Page: link buttons, social icons, images, YouTube videos, text blocks, and a digital business card.
- Arrange blocks into grids or carousels (available with some paid plans).
- Set a Page's colors, font, and header layout.
- Rename a Page, move it to a new short URL, or attach a QR Code to it.

Your plan sets how many Pages you can have at once, and grid and carousel layouts are available with some paid plans.

**Learn more**:

- [Create Bitly Pages with the API](https://dev.bitly.com/docs/tutorials/create-bitly-pages/)
- [What is the Bitly MCP Server?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/44149601528205)
- [What is Bitly Assist?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/44440648181005)


# August 2026

## Tags for QR Codes

You can now add tags to your QR Codes, the same way you already can with your links. Tag a QR Code as you create it, or add tags to any QR Code already in your account from the QR Codes page.

Your tags are shared across your account, so a tag you create on a link is ready to use on a QR Code and the other way around. That means you can group a campaign's links and codes under the same label and find them together.

**Learn more:**

- [How do I add or delete tags on Bitly QR Codes?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/48679923510413)

# July 2026

- [PDF Export for Links and QR Codes](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KZF65JDT9SV8TSNQ2PECN149)
- [Dynamic Routing](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KZF67Y7P6T5R86SX2ZCJRGCN)
- [Period-over-Period Comparisons](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KZF68E2HTAM5C8PXCW2C9B5E)

## PDF Export for Links and QR Codes

Download a one-page performance summary for any individual Bitly Link or QR Code straight from its details page. Click the download icon next to Analytics, and Bitly generates a PDF with your short URL and destination, total clicks or scans, performance trends, and geographic, referrer, and device breakdowns — all scoped to your selected date range.

PDF export is available with some paid plans.

**Learn more:**

- [How do I download a PDF of my Bitly Link or QR Code performance?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/47981563283597)


## Dynamic Routing

Send visitors to different destinations from a single Bitly Link or QR Code based on where they are, what device they're on, or what platform they use. Set up to 10 rules per link or code — Bitly evaluates them top to bottom and redirects each visitor to the first destination that matches. Anyone who doesn't meet a condition lands on the default destination.

Dynamic routing is available with some paid plans.

**Learn more:**

- [What is dynamic routing for Bitly Links?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/47517047714573)
- [What is dynamic routing for Bitly QR Codes?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/47519073494669)

## Period-over-Period Comparisons

See how your links and QR Codes are performing against the previous period. Weekly Insights includes a week-over-week comparison by default, and Analytics dashboards and link and QR Code detail pages now have a comparison toggle that shows your selected period alongside the prior one.

The date range filter includes preset windows of 7 days and 30 days, along with custom ranges — all of which automatically compare against the equivalent prior period.

Period-over-period comparisons are available on all paid Bitly plans.

**Learn more:**

- [How do I view engagement data for a specific link?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/230905028)
- [What are Weekly Insights?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/45355398869901)
- [How do I create Bitly Analytics dashboards?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/26434169117709)

# June 2026

## Bitly Assist enhancements

You can now export chat data directly from a Bitly Assist conversation as a CSV. You can also download an entire conversation history as a PDF. Bitly Assist will also notify you If you're approaching a feature limit, directly in the chat.

**Learn more:**

- [What is Bitly Assist?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/44440648181005)

# May 2026

## Bulk Upload: Redirect and Expiration Support

You can now redirect existing Bitly links to a new destination in bulk. Provide the existing Bitly link and its new destination URL — your click history stays intact, and any title, tags, or expiration you include apply to the redirected link.

**Learn more:**

- [How do I redirect links in bulk?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/45659993228173)

# April 2026

- [Bitly + Notion Integration](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KQ0E2PCETM6Q9KXJEZDJZ79Q)
- [Last active date now available in user export](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KR4EJA4CDZ0E49V626G7RWQP)
- [Set your preferred language directly in Bitly](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KR4EJA4C3D2WZ5C6T9ANS79F)
- [Bitly Weekly Insights](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KR4EJA4CNN9M592A1796HNBR)

## Bitly + Notion Integration

You can now generate Bitly links directly inside Notion — no tab switching, no copy-pasting. The Bitly + Notion integration is available now on the Bitly Integration's Marketplace.

What you can do:

- Generate short links inside Notion databases with support for custom domains, UTMs, and custom back-halves
- Create a QR Code alongside any link you generate

**Learn more:**

- [Can I integrate Bitly with Notion?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/45185234622605)

## Last active date now available in user export

Organization admins can now see a **Last Active** column when exporting user data from Settings. This makes it easier to identify inactive users and manage your org.

To access this data:

1. Log in and go to **Settings.**
2. Navigate to the **Users** section.
3. Select **Export** to download the user list.
4. The **Last Active** column will appear in the exported file.

A few things to keep in mind:

The Last Active column only appears in the export — it is not visible in the settings.

Only org admins can access the user export.

**Learn more**:

- [How do I export user information for my Enterprise account?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/24765332747533)


## Set your preferred language directly in Bitly

You can now choose your preferred display language directly in your Bitly profile settings — no more relying on your browser's language detection. Head to **Settings** → **Profile** and select your language. Every part of the Bitly app will follow your preference automatically.

As we continue expanding language support, any new additions will appear in the same place.

- 🇧🇷 Brazilian Portuguese
- 🇺🇸 English
- 🇫🇷 French
- 🇩🇪 German
- 🇮🇳 Hindi
- 🇮🇹 Italian
- 🇪🇸 Spanish
- 🇮🇳 Tamil
- 🇹🇭 Thai

**Learn more**:

- [How do I set my preferred language in my Bitly account?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/45708135980557)

## Bitly Weekly Insights

Your Analytics Overview now includes a weekly performance summary that tells you what's working, what's changing, and what to try next — automatically, in plain language.

Each week, Insights surfaces up to three findings from your data: top-performing links, most active days, leading referrers, top locations, and device breakdowns (based on your plan). Each insight comes with a plain-language description and one actionable recommendation so you can act on the data, not just read it.

Also included:

- A weekly performance graph showing total engagements over time for links, QR Codes, and Bitly Page button clicks.
- A downloadable PDF of your weekly summary to share with your team.
- Contextual prompts to take your insights deeper with Bitly Assist.

![](https://support.bitly.com/hc/article_attachments/45356089376525)

Weekly Insights are  available to customers on paid plans. Free users can preview what's available when they upgrade.

**Learn more**:

- [What are Weekly Insights?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/45355398869901)

# March 2026

- [Copilot and Bitly](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KNWDYB0F5WM35F1NPSEP7GBA)
- [Bitly Assist](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KNWH5V3QFH0SJ5SKFA7QQ671)

- [High Volume Static QR Code API](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KNWKZ0H0PZWYPYFT071X0VE1)

## Copilot and Bitly

You can now integrate Bitly's link and QR Code management capabilities directly into Microsoft Copilot. Create links in bulk, pull analytics insights, and apply naming conventions and UTM parameters automatically — all without leaving your AI assistant. Along with our existing ChatGPT and Claude integrations, Bitly is now available across core LLMs, bringing link management to wherever you work.

Learn more about integrating Bitly with Copilot

**Learn more**:

- [Can I integrate Bitly with Copilot?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/44079403730573)

## Bitly Assist

Bitly Assist is an AI-powered chat assistant built right into Bitly. Ask questions about your link and QR Code performance in plain language, create and configure links and QR Codes conversationally, and move between analysis and action — all from a persistent side panel without leaving your Bitly workflow. Bitly Assist is available to customers on paid plans.

**Learn more**:

- [What is Bitly Assist?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/44440648181005)

## Shopify and Bitly

Connect Bitly with your Shopify store to see which links and QR Codes actually drive sales, not just clicks. Create branded short links for your products and collections directly in Shopify, and track orders, revenue, and conversion rates for every link back to your store. See your Shopify links and QR codes and view metrics within the Bitly app.

**Learn more**:

- [Shopify page on the Bitly Apps and Integrations Marketplace](https://bitly.com/pages/marketplace/shopify)
- [Can I Integrate Bitly with Shopify?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/42092803402381)

## Integrations discovery page

Explore and activate integrations in one place, right inside Bitly. Browse a searchable catalog of available integrations, filter by your needs, and start activation flows directly from the page. Whether you're connecting to Shopify, Slack, or your favorite AI assistant, the new integrations discovery page makes it easier to find the tools that extend what Bitly can do for your workflow.

Go to the **Integrations** tab on the left side menu to start exmporing our integrations!

![](https://support.bitly.com/hc/article_attachments/45006846815885)

## High Volume Static QR Code API

Enterprise customers can now generate static QR Codes at scale with a new API endpoint, supporting up to 500,000 QR Codes per hour as a paid add-on. This is ideal for high-volume use cases that need simple, fast QR Code generation without link management, analytics, or customization. Contact your account team to learn more.

**Learn more**:

- [How do I create QR Codes via the Bitly API?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/11643281008781)


# February 2026

## Set expiration dates for link & QR Codes

You now have control over when your Bitly Links and QR Codes stop working. Set a specific date and time for any link or QR Code to automatically expire. This is perfect for time-sensitive campaigns, limited-time offers, or content with a built-in end date.

When a link or QR Code expires:

- Clicks redirect to a Bitly 410 page, or a custom error page if you've set one up on your custom domain
- Any QR Code attached to the link also stops working
- You can reactivate an expired link at any time by editing its expiration settings

Link expiration is available on Growth plans and above

**Learn more**:

- [How do I set an expiration date for my links and QR Codes?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/43445764258957)

# January 2026

## Download PDFs of your analytics dashboard

Share your performance data with stakeholders faster than ever. Each of your Analytics dashboards can now be downloaded to a PDF. This change makes it easy to add professional visualizations to presentations, reports, or share insights with your team.

**Learn more:**

- [How do I download a PDF of an Analytics dashboard?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/43292490568845)

# December 2025

## LINE Messenger and Bitly

LINE is a popular app for instant messaging and social networking, with 194 million users primarily in Japan, Taiwan, and Thailand. The Bitly integration is a chatbot inside LINE Messenger that lets you shorten links and access analytics on-demand, without leaving your conversations. This conversational interface is similar to our MCP and LLM integrations, making it easy to create and manage Bitly links right where you're already working.

**Learn more:**

- [Can I Integrate Bitly with LINE Messenger?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/41983794250125)
- [LINE messenger page on the Bitly Apps and Integrations Marketplace](https://bitly.com/pages/marketplace/line-messaging)

# October 2025

- [Multi-create on Quick-create on the Bitly homepage](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KD634WA59AXXPGSDQEW0PHAZ)
- [Slack and Bitly](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KD633BVZTTWA53SGHHBSS453)
- [Changes to the Bitly Mobile app](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01KD60SNYSW10KQ2XRP64K149B)

## Multi-create on Quick-create on the Bitly homepage

With this change, you are able to shorten links and create QR codes at the same from the Bitly homepage. Make links and QR codes easier and faster than ever with this new feature!

![](https://support.bitly.com/hc/article_attachments/42174630655245)

![](https://support.bitly.com/hc/article_attachments/42174590219789)

**Learn more:**

- [How do I create links with Bitly?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/230897128)
- [How do I create a QR Code in Bitly?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/360030557072)

## Slack and Bitly

Bring powerful link management from Bitly directly into your Slack workspace. Connect your Bitly account to shorten links with your custom domains, track click performance, and generate QR Codes - all without leaving Slack.

Take advantage of slash commands to perform Bitly actions within your Slack channels and DMs.

**Learn more:**

- [Can I integrate Bitly with Slack?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/41331503654797)
- [Slack page on the Bitly Apps and Integrations Marketplace](https://bitly.com/pages/marketplace/slack)

## Check Bitly Links from the mobile app

Want to quickly see where a Bitly link is headed on your mobile device? In this IOS update, 3.0.1, We’ve added a way for you to easily see the destination of a Bitly link with or without a login. Confirm that any Bitly link is where you expect it to send you right within the Bitly app.

**Learn more:**

- [Can I check a Bitly link's destination before clicking on it?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/230650447)

# September 2025

- [Hide links directly from the link card](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01K6NRTJ1BSZ56JYV92NR21T5Y)
- [Editing a link's back-half now creates its own link card](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01K3VQB8FK3MCG40B4Z5DXDB5Z)

## Hide links directly from the link card

As well as hiding links in bulk, you can now hide a link directly from the link card. This allows for quick clean up when reviewing your links. When you hide a link, it remains in your account and continues to work when anyone clicks it, but it's not visible on your links page or in your analytics.

![Select Hide Link.png](https://support.bitly.com/hc/article_attachments/40077413730701)

**Learn more:**

- [How do I hide links?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/19439352051981)

## Editing a link's back-half now creates its own link card

Now when you edit a link's back-half, a new dedicated link card is created within the Links Page. This change allows you to [see engagements](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/230905028) for that specific back-half. Previously, when you edited a link's back-half, the existing link card would update and the previous link version’s metrics would show within the link card.

This change also applies to all previously edited links within your Bitly account. Any link with an edited back-half will now display its own dedicated link card on the Link's Page. You might see several new cards in your Bitly account due to this change.

If you prefer to not see certain versions of a link on your Links Page, you can [hide your links](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/19439352051981).

Link titles stay the same when you make edits to a link’s back-half, different back-halves show underneath the link’s title.

![Link Back-Half Edit.png](https://support.bitly.com/hc/article_attachments/39705519611149)

**Learn more:**

- [What happens when I edit a link's back-half?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/21972882834445)
- [How do I edit a link in Bitly?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001355412)
- [How do Bitly Links, Bitly Codes, and Bitly Pages work together?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/360001355412)

# August 2025

## Create again button for links and QR Codes

Need to create multiple links or QR Codes? The new create again button makes it effortless. Just create a link or QR Code, then click create again to repeat the process with one click.![Create Again buttonshot 2025-10-02 at 5.34.15 PM.png](https://support.bitly.com/hc/article_attachments/40077413735181)

# July 2025

- [Text blocks for Pages](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01K3VQ6MJCVQKQ2082VHJ7FJBJ)
- [ChatGPT and Bitly](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01K1KK7SH64WR97EZWZC7TQKKG)

## Text blocks for Pages

The new Text Block feature on Bitly Pages allows you to add customizable text directly to their Pages. You can create more dynamic and flexible messaging with customization options like:

- Change the font size
- Apply formatting like bold, italics, or underline
- Change the text color
- Adjust the alignment (left, center, right)

**Learn more**:

- [How do I add text blocks to a Bitly Page?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/38658404719373)
- [What kinds of content can I put on a Bitly Page?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/24586780283405)

## ChatGPT + Bitly Integration

Bitly’s custom GPT is a ChatGPT integration that securely connects to your Bitly account, allowing you to manage your links and QR Codes with AI. With Bitly’s custom GPT, you can shorten URLs, create QR Codes, view analytics, and manage campaigns through natural language chat.

**Learn more**:

- [Can I integrate Bitly with ChatGPT?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/37571411427085)
- [ChatGPT page on the Bitly Apps and Integrations Marketplace](https://bitly.com/pages/marketplace/chatgpt)

# June 2025

- [Bitly is now SOC 2 compliant](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01JXZ3HX7M6GJ71JG5463R7K38)
- [Create multiple links or QR Codes to the same destination](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01JX2YZG63NASA6HVBAECSPQY8)

## Bitly is now SOC 2 compliant

We are proud to announce that Bitly is SOC 2 compliant.

This milestone reinforces our commitment to protecting your data with industry-leading security standards. It means an independent auditor confirmed we’re doing all the right things to keep your information safe.

SOC 2 standards include:

- Continuous monitoring to catch issues before they become problems
- Strict access controls (only the right people get access to data)
- Regular security training for our Bitly team

Why it matters:

You trust us with your data every time you shorten a link or create a QR Code. With SOC 2, you can rest assured that your information is now protected according to the highest security standards.

Learn more about our security practices on our [Security Center](https://security.bitly.com/).

## Create multiple links or QR Codes to the same destination

You can now create multiple links or QR Codes that point to the same destination. Each created link or QR Code have their own analytics which allows you to test if different back-halves or QR Code designs perform better than others. This also gives you the ability to customize your links or QR Codes for different audiences.

**Learn more:**

- [Can I create multiple links to the same destination?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/23172931775117)
- [Can I create multiple QR Codes to the same destination?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/19616856377869)

# May 2025

- [Bitly + Twitch Integration](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01JX0EFRMQ10E2E83EC77W9NFZ)
- [Bitly + Adobe Express Integration](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01JX06X5B6JXJJGDG8RTHXQNW5)

## Bitly + Twitch Integration

With the new Bitly + Twitch integration you can now create and share short links and QR Codes right from your Twitch Creator Dashboard. Perfect for sharing short link and QR Codes with your live audience.

**Learn more**:

- [Twitch page on the Bitly Apps and Integrations Marketplace](https://bitly.com/pages/marketplace/twitch)
- [Can I connect Bitly to Twitch?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/37164361699085)

## Bitly + Adobe Express Integration

The new Bitly + Adobe Express integration allows you to create and share short links and QR Codes for your designs without ever leaving Adobe Express. Any QR Codes or short links you create in-app can be accessed again anytime within Adobe Express or in your Bitly account.

**Learn more**:

- [Adobe Express page on the Bitly Apps and Integrations Marketplace](https://bitly.com/pages/marketplace/adobe-express)
- [Can I integrate Bitly with Adobe Express?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/35344615120269)

# April 2025

## Changes to the Bitly mobile app

Create short links, share instantly, and monitor performance–all from your phone.

Features:

- Instant link creation: Create shortened URLs tailored to your brand, including custom domains and back-halves.
- Simple link sharing: Share your shortened links directly from the app via text, email, or social media.
- Quick access: View your recently created links for convenient reuse.
- Tracking essentials: View click counts for your links to monitor performance.

Looking for QR Codes, landing pages, or detailed analytics?

Visit Bitly.com on your mobile or desktop browser to access your Bitly account, where you can build stronger digital connections with our full suite of URL shortening, QR Code, and landing page products.

**Learn more:**

- [Get the Bitly app](https://bitly.com/pages/mobile-app)
- [Does Bitly have a mobile app?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/360002305231)

# March 2025

- [Changes to bulk upload](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01JSQ4VEC2CAK55R9EWW4D0C0E)
- [Create QR Codes without automatically attaching a short link](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/34262355353997-What-s-new-at-Bitly#h_01JSQ1X6GCSX9KAS3X6EX5HVAV)

## Changes to bulk upload

The new bulk upload allows you to create standalone QR Codes in bulk with a CSV or Excel file. We also added the option to create paired QR Codes and short links in bulk with the enhancements to our link bulk upload feature. This is an easy way to quickly shorten links, create QR codes at scale, or migrate links to Bitly from different platforms.

**Learn more**:

- [What is bulk upload?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/360055843132)
- [How do I shorten links in bulk?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/360056277331)
- [How do I create QR Codes in bulk?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/25227111392397)

## Create QR Codes without automatically attaching a short link

QR Codes are now fully detached from links, meaning that creating a QR Code will no longer automatically generate a short link. When creating a new QR Code, you have the option to create a paired short link or stand alone QR Code. If you choose to create a QR Code without a link, you'll still be able to add a link to an existing QR Code at a later time.

**Benefits:**

- You will no longer automatically be charged for a short link when you create a QR Code.
- Gives you flexibility when creating QR Codes to create only what you need.

**Learn more**:

- [How do I create a QR Code in Bitly?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/360030557072)

## GS1-compliant 2D Barcodes via the Bitly API

## This feature is available with some [paid plans](https://bitly.com/pages/pricing)

The Bitly API can be used to create 2D Barcodes. These are QR Codes that can be used much like a traditional barcode, while being able to store and communicate much more information.

Our 2D Barcodes are compliant with GS1 standards, the most widely-used supply chain standards in the world. They can store a Global Trade Identification Number (GTIN) so that a product can be scanned at checkout, as well as store other customer-facing information like expiration dates, sourcing information, and more.

2D Barcodes use the same API endpoint as our other QR Codes.

**Learn more**:

- [What are 2D Barcodes?](https://support.bitly.com/hc/en-us/articles/22899954095757-What-are-2D-Barcodes)
- [How 2D Barcodes Are Revolutionizing the Retail and CPG Industry](https://bitly.com/blog/introducing-2d-barcodes/)
- [About GS1 US](https://www.gs1us.org/who-we-are/about-us)

## Bitly QR Codes API endpoint

There's a new version of our API endpoint for QR Codes. This new endpoint has more functionality, allowing you to create QR Codes without associated links, create GS1-compliant 2D Barcodes, and more.

It's also possible to make very simple requests to the new endpoint. When you visit our site for developers to get [more information about the endpoint](https://dev.bitly.com/api-reference/#createQRCodePublic), we have sample requests on the right side of the screen. From the dropdown in the Create QR Code section, select **Minimal** to view an example of a simple one.

If you currently use the Bitly API to create, edit, or retrieve QR Codes, you're likely using the previous version of this endpoint. Your requests to the previous endpoint continue to work, but moving to the new version will make more functionality available to you.
